name: Ecoboard Industries Limited
about: Ecoboard Industries Limited manufactures and sells particle boards under the Ecoboard brand name in India. The company operates through EcoBuild and EcoEnergy segments. It offers building material products, such as EcoWal, EcoDek, EcoFurn home, EcoDor, EcoFreeze, EcoCil home, EcoRak, acoustic, EcoPac, EcoFurn office, and EcoCil office under EcoBuild division; and bio-energy solutions, including condensate polishing unit, plug & play BG, effluent treatment plant, continuous stirring type reactor, upflow anaerobic sludge blanket, liquid waste management, solid waste management, waste to energy, and heat logs under EcoEnergy division. It also offers products, including EcoCraft, high duty ultra moisture resistant panels, EcoGames, EcoMarble, EcoPEB homes, GypEco, and EcoFlr which caters to industries, such as living spaces, hospitality, health care, and commercial spaces. The company also exports its products. Ecoboard Industries Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Pune, India.
